name: National Cadet Corps (NCC) Scholarship
department: Youth Welfare and Sports Development Department
benefit: Annual scholarship amount to support education.
eligibility_rules: NCC cadets with good attendance and performance in training.
how_to_apply: Through NCC unit officer and head of institution.
